purpose: Guarantee OWNER ACCEPTS CAPABILITY -> DURABLE INTAKE -> RESEARCH ADOPTION RECORD -> CAPABILITY RECORD -> ROADMAP CONSIDERATION -> PLANNER CONSUMPTION. No accepted capability may disappear between stages.

atomic_intake_stages.1_intake: Append to governance/research-intake-ledger.json (research-intake-ledger) with classification ACCEPTED (Owner-decided).
atomic_intake_stages.2_adoption: Append to governance/research-adoption-ledger.json as research adoption record (status at least PLANNED).
atomic_intake_stages.3_capability: Capability-index record exists or is appended (status e.g. PLANNED/PARTIAL/FOUNDATION_READY_WITH_GAP).
atomic_intake_stages.4_roadmap: One of: (A) own roadmap item; (B) explicitly enumerated composition into existing roadmap item; (C) explicit DEFER with reason; (D) explicit REJECTED/SUPERSEDED with Owner decision.
atomic_intake_stages.5_planner: Planner consumes the durable sources; forward+reverse coverage gates pass.

failure_semantics: If any stage after acceptance has not succeeded, intake remains INCOMPLETE: INTAKE_INCOMPLETE = TRUE, ROADMAP_COVERAGE_GAP = TRUE, PLAN_COMPLETE = FALSE, RECOMMENDED_NEXT_GOAL = null.
no_duplicate_truth: research-intake-ledger.json remains the ONLY pending-accepted intake store; development-control.json research_decisions remains authoritative for its 8 pre-existing subjects (inherited_decisions). No second competing ledger is created. The intake ledger is an explicit bridge into the Research Adoption Ledger: ACCEPTED classification MUST be followed by an adoption record before the owning goal can claim closure.
provenance_rule: Chat memory alone is non-authoritative. An accepted decision that exists only as prose must be recorded in this contract's pipeline; orphan decision artifacts must be indexed in the intake ledger (decision_ref) — an unindexed .md decision outside governance/docs/p2p-development conventions is detected as an orphan.
future_workflow: Whenever Owner says 'adopt this' / 'add this capability' / 'put this into P2P' (or equivalent explicit acceptance) in an authorized P2P development flow, the handling goal MUST persist the full intake before claiming closure. Terminal check: OWNER_SELECTED_CAPABILITY_RECORDED = VERIFIED. If persistence fails, the goal cannot claim full closure.
capability_to_roadmap_enumeration_policy: OWNER_ACCEPTED_PROPOSAL capabilities are enumerated into an existing roadmap item's canonical_capability_ids (option B, spec §8) rather than spawning a new roadmap item, except when the Owner explicitly directs a new item. Capabilities without material intent (PROJECT_LEARNING, RECOVERED_LEGACY registry entries) are documented inventory and are excluded from the coverage gate.

amendments.change: vocabulary extension (append-only): intake classifications PENDING_OWNER_APPROVAL and PLANNED_NEXT are documented canonical states in durable intake records RI-002/RI-004/RI-005/RI-006 (Owner-pending requests, not unknown decisions). They satisfy the strict-binding vocabulary gate; they never satisfy material materiality on their own.
